request.state:
Icelandic original: „(Brimnesá) Fjallið er einstaklega fallegt á haustin því þá skartar það öllum fegurstu haustlitunum þar sem fjallið er þakið berjalyngi.“
English gloss: “(Brimnesá) The mountain is particularly beautiful in autumn because then it displays all the most beautiful autumn colours where the mountain is covered with birch trees.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
